name: relay_live_lanes_exclusion_reasons_lq736_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: RELAY_LIVE_LANES_EXCLUSION_REASONS_LQ736_20261108 — LQ-20261107-736: the relay live-list render never drops a lane silently.
registry_live_lanes now writes a reason into `excluded` for EVERY registry row that carries a live claim (dispatch block,
scheduler.stage, scheduler.kind n8n, or a non-null allowlist live_arg). Before this, a non-live dispatch.mode short-circuited
with no entry, so 48 shadow/dry_run rows in the real registry (and 4 native n8n rows, and cron rows carrying a live argv)
left the render with an EMPTY excluded map and only the lane count moved. The gate pins: dispatch_mode:{dry_run|off|unset},
bad_dispatch_block:not_mapping, native_n8n_no_stage for every native n8n row without a stage, stage_<shadow>, scheduler_<kind>_not_n8n
for a live argv on a non-n8n row, a negative control (a row with no claim is not named), completeness over the real registry,
the LQ-716 lane still live and unexcluded, and that the reasons reach the rendered artifact.
Hermetic: synthetic one-row registries plus the repo's own config files read-only; no state root, no DB, no n8n, no live argv.
